<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has responded and identified a common available time for all four partners: Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. My next and final task is to book this meeting in the firm's booking system.

After creating the booking, I need to inform Brad so he can send the confirmation email to the partners. Posting a message to the shared workspace is the way to do this.

I'll start by creating the booking.
